entities.name: Kebwin
entities.description: Dwarven son of Spenggra who will possibly be an orc of the Ironclaw Hills in a potential future; dies from the strange dreaming.

entities.name: Somilar
entities.description: Orcish daughter of Kalin, left catatonic by the dreams.

entities.name: Ironclaw Hills
entities.description: Region where children dream of an ancient war.

entities.name: Benalish
entities.description: Plains people who make war on the races of the mountains in the dreams.

events.summary: In a potential future, Ironclaw Hills children dream of a war 3000 years in the past and wake bruised and battered.
events.quote: The children start temporarily vanishing during sleep and waking up bruised and battered.

events.summary: The dreaming stops, but Somilar is catatonic and Kebwin is dead.
events.quote: by then Somilar is catatonic and Kebwin is dead
